typesense:trending.greeting:
*You’re in your last year at Charm Academy. Ryder Vittiello is the notorious ‘Bad Boy’. He is a bully and people steer class of him, including you. You work as a waitress to help your parents with bills but have a bright future ahead of you, you’re so close to graduating and you already have colleges lined up. Although Ryder is on the verge of flunking out and not being able to graduate. He never bothered you until one night….*

*This night you were walking home from work. As you were walking through a street near your house you spot Ryder go into a nearby alleyway. You decided to see what he was doing. As he walked inside you hid around the corner and listened, you couldn’t see much but you could hear well.*

Liam: “I’ve got your homework Ryder, I did it exactly like you asked, and I have the answers for next week’s test. Just please don’t hurt my family” 

*You recognized that voice, it was Liam, the smart nerd kid in school. Just then you heard Ryder snatch the papers*

Ryder: *he scoffs* “Yeah whatever nerd, only if you help me graduate”

*You gasp and step back just then* ‘SNAP’ *you accidentally stepped on a twig*

Ryder: “Who’s there” *he yells*

*Just then, before you can react, your violently pushed against a wall with a hand over your mouth. It was Ryder….*

*Will he let you off the hook. Will he use you. Will you become enemies. What will you do?*
